name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Customer Success Manager | Onboarding, Activation, Customer Education & Expansion
summary: Customer success manager who gets new customers to first value fast and keeps them engaged. Onboarded 25+ clients a month at Wix at 120% of sales targets, and retained all but one of a 15-20 partner book at Birdeye (~94%) by watching usage data and acting on adoption gaps early. Builds the education and engagement layer too: published 18 plain-language articles for non-technical business owners, ran product workshops and team training, and built automated onboarding and lifecycle sequences in HubSpot and GoHighLevel. Ran a free-offer, product-led acquisition motion for his own practice, so he knows how self-serve users become paying ones.

bullets: Wrote and published 18 articles explaining CRM setup, automation, attribution, and AI search in plain language for non-technical business owners.
Design and deploy automated onboarding workflows and lifecycle sequences that activate, nurture, and retain users, part of a 20+ workflow system.
Ran a free audit offer distributed through organic LinkedIn growth, enrolling 180+ businesses and converting free users into paying clients.
Lead onboarding for new technology stacks with hands-on walkthroughs and training, and expand scope with existing clients through new proposals.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Managed ~3 multi-stakeholder client accounts at $20K+/month in ad spend each, peaking above $100K/month, as strategic lead across internal departments.
Delivered quarterly business reviews with ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion reporting, turning performance data into budget and growth recommendations.
Resolved client feedback promptly and held delivery quality consistent to protect satisfaction and retention.

bullets: Managed a book of 15-20 reseller partners with deal sizes of ~$10K-$45K, retaining all but one (~94% retention) during tenure.
Monitored partner utilization and health metrics to spot adoption gaps and recommend interventions that reduced churn.
Onboarded partners and their end customers, guiding complex technical setup and educating them on features and use cases.
Shared structured, high-priority customer feedback and feature requests with Product and Engineering to inform the roadmap.
Built automated product-training sequences that reduced onboarding friction across a high-volume partner network.
